verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automation feature, such as workflows, triggers, or scheduled agents, that an AI-native user could set up to run on their own. What LegalZoom does offer is managed services: auto-filing of annual reports, deadline reminders, and compliance notifications that LegalZoom itself runs. These are adjacent service features, not a capability for users to build their own background automations, so they earn no credit for this story.
